Accessibility Remediation Guide - Step-by-Step Implementation

This guide provides exact code changes needed to fix all critical and major accessibility issues.

REMEDIATION 1: Color Contrast Fixes (30 minutes)

File: /assets/main.scss

Change 1.1: Secondary Text Color (Line 11)

// BEFORE:
$secondary: #7f8c8d !default;         // Muted gray for secondary text

// AFTER:
$secondary: #555555 !default;         // Darker gray: 6.2:1 contrast (PASSES AAA)

Affected Elements: - Blog post subtitles - Category labels
- Author/date metadata - Secondary headings

Change 1.2: Gray-600 Color (Line 25)

// BEFORE:
$gray-600: #6c757d !default;          // Medium gray

// AFTER:
$gray-600: #5a6268 !default;          // Darker gray: 4.6:1 contrast (PASSES AA)

Affected Elements: - Secondary text throughout - Footer text - Metadata

Change 1.3: Info Color (Line 13)

// BEFORE:
$info: #3498db !default;              // Clean blue for info states

// AFTER:
$info: #004085 !default;              // Bootstrap standard: 9.48:1 (PASSES AAA)

Affected Elements: - Info callout boxes - Informational alerts - Status indicators

Change 1.4: Warning Color (Line 14)

// BEFORE:
$warning: #f39c12 !default;           // Warm orange for warnings

// AFTER:
$warning: #856404 !default;           // Bootstrap standard: 6.47:1 (PASSES AA)
// OR (for AAA compliance):
// $warning: #664d03 !default;         // Even darker: 8.1:1 (PASSES AAA)

Affected Elements: - Warning alerts - Cautionary elements - Important notices

Change 1.5: Danger Color (Line 15)

// BEFORE:
$danger: #e74c3c !default;            // Clean red for errors

// AFTER:
$danger: #dc3545 !default;            // Bootstrap standard: 4.54:1 (PASSES AA)
// OR (for AAA compliance):
// $danger: #c71c22 !default;          // Darker red: 6.8:1 (PASSES AAA)

Affected Elements: - Error messages - Error states - Danger actions

Change 1.6: Link Hover Color (Line 69)

// BEFORE:
$link-hover-color: #e17055 !default; // soft coral for contrast against cream

// AFTER (pick one):
$link-hover-color: #c45827 !default; // Darker coral: 5.2:1 (PASSES AA)
// OR
$link-hover-color: #d64045 !default; // Red-orange: 4.8:1 (PASSES AA)
// OR
$link-hover-color: #b85c1f !default; // Burnt orange: 5.5:1 (PASSES AA)

Affected Elements: - Navigation link hover states - Blog link hover states - All hyperlink hover states

Change 1.7: Form Note Text (Lines 461-465)

// BEFORE:
.subscription-note {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: $gray-500;              // #adb5bd = 3.90:1 (INSUFFICIENT)
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

// AFTER:
.subscription-note {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: #555555;                // 6.2:1 contrast (PASSES AAA)
  // OR use the updated $gray-600 instead:
  // color: $gray-600;            // 4.6:1 (PASSES AA)
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

REMEDIATION 2: Subscribe Button Focus Indicator (10 minutes)

File: /assets/main.scss

Replace the entire .subscribe-btn block (lines 440-459):

// BEFORE:
.subscribe-btn {
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  background-color: $primary;
  color: $white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: $border-radius-sm;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: $font-weight-medium;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease-in-out;

  &:hover {
    background-color: darken($primary, 10%);
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 400px;
  }
}

// AFTER:
.subscribe-btn {
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  background-color: $primary;
  color: $white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: $border-radius-sm;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: $font-weight-medium;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease-in-out, 
              outline 0.15s ease-in-out,
              box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out;

  &:hover {
    background-color: darken($primary, 10%);
  }

  /* Focus visible - for keyboard users */
  &:focus {
    outline: 3px solid $primary;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  /* Enhanced focus styling (modern browsers) */
  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid $primary;
    outline-offset: 2px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba($primary, 0.3);
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 400px;
  }
}

Impact: - Keyboard users can now see when button has focus - Visible blue outline and shadow around button - Improves keyboard navigation experience significantly

REMEDIATION 3: Email Form Accessibility (15 minutes)

File: /blog.qmd (Lines 23-41)

Step 1: Add visually-hidden CSS class to SCSS

In /assets/main.scss, add after other utility classes:

// Accessible label hiding - keeps label in DOM for screen readers
.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border-width: 0;
}

Step 2: Update Form HTML in blog.qmd

::: {.subscription-box}
## Get notified of new blog posts

Stay up-to-date with my latest posts on data science, social science, and full-stack engineering.

```{=html}
<form class="email-subscription-form" action="#" method="post">
  <div class="subscription-container">
    <!-- ADDED: Proper label for accessibility -->
    <label for="email-input" class="visually-hidden">Email address</label>
    
    <!-- UPDATED: Added id and aria-describedby -->
    <input type="email"
      id="email-input"
      name="email"
      placeholder="Enter your email address"
      required
      class="email-input"
      aria-describedby="email-note">
      
    <button type="submit" class="subscribe-btn">Subscribe</button>
  </div>
  
  <!-- ADDED: id for aria-describedby -->
  <p id="email-note" class="subscription-note">No spam, ever. Unsubscribe at any time.</p>
</form>

:::


**What Changed:**
1. Added `<label>` element with `for="email-input"` linking to input
2. Hidden label visually but kept for screen reader access
3. Added `id="email-input"` to input field
4. Added `aria-describedby="email-note"` to connect input to helper text
5. Added `id="email-note"` to paragraph for the aria-describedby connection

**Benefits:**
- Screen readers announce "Email address" when field is focused
- Placeholder text no longer serves as the only label
- Helper text is semantically connected to input
- Better accessibility for assistive tech users

REMEDIATION 5: Logo Alt Text (5 minutes)

The logo is generated by Quarto from the _quarto.yml configuration. You have two options:

Option A: Add aria-label to navbar (Preferred if using custom template)

Modify Quarto navbar template to add aria-label:

<a href="./index.html" class="navbar-brand navbar-brand-logo" aria-label="Jeremy R. Winget, PhD - Home">
    <img src="./assets/img/logo.png" alt="" class="navbar-logo">
</a>

Option B: Update alt text (Simple solution)

In the Quarto configuration, the logo is set in _quarto.yml:

website:
  navbar:
    logo: /assets/img/logo.png

Unfortunately, Quarto doesn’t directly support alt text in the navbar config, so Option A (adding to template) is preferred. However, you could add an aria-label to the logo configuration if Quarto supports it, or modify the template.

REMEDIATION 6: Optional - Skip-to-Content Link (15 minutes)

File: /assets/main.scss

Add this CSS class:

// Skip-to-main content link (keyboard accessibility)
.skip-to-main {
  position: absolute;
  top: -40px;
  left: 0;
  background: #000;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  text-decoration: none;
  z-index: 10000;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;

  &:focus {
    top: 0;
  }
}

File: Quarto template or HTML header

Add as first visible element in <body>:

<a href="#quarto-document-content" class="skip-to-main">Skip to main content</a>

Purpose: - Allows keyboard users to bypass navigation and jump to main content - Hidden off-screen until focused - Saves keyboard users from tabbing through entire navbar

VERIFICATION CHECKLIST

After implementing fixes, verify:

Color Contrast

Alt Text

Form Accessibility

Focus Indicators

Testing Tools

Automated Testing

  1. Axe DevTools - Chrome/Firefox extension
    • Run scan on each page
    • Fix any reported contrast issues
    • Verify alt text
  2. WAVE - Browser extension (webaim.org)
    • Check for contrast errors
    • Verify forms and labels
    • Check for missing alt text
  3. Lighthouse - Built into Chrome DevTools
    • Run accessibility audit
    • Check performance impact of changes

Manual Testing

  1. Keyboard Navigation
    • Use Tab to navigate entire page
    • Use Shift+Tab to go backward
    • Test all forms and buttons
  2. Screen Reader
    • Windows: NVDA (free)
    • Mac: VoiceOver (built-in)
    • Test form labels and alt text
  3. High Contrast Mode
    • Windows: Settings → Ease of Access → High Contrast
    • Ensure focus indicators still visible
  4. Zoom Test
    • Zoom to 200%
    • Check for content overflow
    • Verify text remains readable

Total: 2.5 hours
